flags.message: The provisioned appendix is marked truncated, and its pipeline omission begins during the central NMCCA Rule 403 analysis at App. 104, removing the remainder of that opinion, including App. 104-106 cited by the petition. Other record excerpts are also cut. Available App. 98-104 and 201-202 were used; the petition's account of omitted reasoning could not be independently checked. Prediction completed conservatively; no outcome material was sought.
